text:
sam: FYI staging deploy got stuck behind the new access-brake. Canary abort triggered and fallback didn't run.

deploy-bot: canary aborted — reason=ACCESS_CHECK_FAILED, code=403

sam: Steps: 1) start canary 2) observe /ops/deploy API -> 403 3) fallback pipeline didn't trigger

elaine: hmm did we just roll the RBAC role mapping yesterday? that change touched deploy-service role

kevin: I saw the KMS rotation note too. Could policy on the KMS key be blocking service account decrypt? :thinking:

sam: logs attached (below). audit shows deploy-service failed 'kms:Decrypt' then 'rbac:authorize' fallback denied

devsec: paste logs? also include last successful request id

sam: ```json
{
  "time":"2026-03-18T14:02:11Z",
  "req_id":"canary-uuid-1234",
  "principal":"svc-deploy@redwood",
  "action":"kms:Decrypt",
  "resource":"projects/redwood/keys/deploy-fallback-key",
  "result":"DENIED",
  "policy_check":"allow-deploy (requires env:canary=true)",
  "note":"decryption failed before attribute parsing"
}
```

elaine: snippet shows principal=svc-deploy@redwood with role=deploy-runner-v2, attempt=canary-uuid-1234 -> denied by policy 'allow-deploy' because missing attr 'env:canary=true'

ops-oncall: that attr check was added in the gate change last week, intended for A/B feature. If KMS denies, attributes don't get decoded.

kevin: so KMS failure causes token decryption to fail and we short-circuit to deny. fallback relies on a fallback-token that we didn't surface.

sam: reproduce steps and a quick mitigation: manual run of fallback with admin-token works. Can we make fallback try service-account alternative when KMS fails?

elaine: mitigation: add retry path for KMS Decrypt failures to attempt cached plaintext or use dedicated fallback-key. Need review from infra.

devsec: filing incident ticket: INC-2026-1447. Triage notes: impact=staging-canary-blocked, severity=medium, root-cause=RBAC gating coupled to KMS-decrypt without retry. Recommendation: short-circuit transient decrypt errors to retry and alert.

ops-oncall: rolling a patch to 0.1.1 on staging to add 3s backoff + fallback-key attempt. Will monitor.

sam: thanks. Assigning follow-ups: @elaine check RBAC attribute gating, @kevin confirm KMS rotation impact, @devsec produce postmortem draft.

elaine: acknowledged :white_check_mark:

kevin: on it, I'll check IAM and KMS logs.

devsec: ping me when regression test added for decryption failures.

deploy-bot: deploy started 1850032320 -> patch v0.1.1

ops-oncall: patch passed canary, fallback exercised successfully, closing thread unless anyone objects

sam: closing, will put postmortem link here when ready :bow:
